$comment: Upload limits, bundled with the app and editable in Settings.
The app may also refresh this file from a remote URL, so a platform
changing its cap does not require shipping a new release.
Sizes are decimal MB (10^6). Platforms disagree about whether they mean
MB or MiB, which is exactly why every target gets a safety margin.

presets.label: Free
presets.note: Raised from 10 MB on 13 August 2026. Was 25 MB before 2024.

presets.label: Boosted server, level 2
presets.note: Applies to every member of that server, Nitro or not.

presets.label: Boosted server, level 3
presets.note: Discord uses whichever is larger: your account cap or the server's.
